problem: POS browser preview showed 150 KGS while the actual discounted return posted 135. Source inspection showed standalone history also derived its preview and submission from gross unit prices; no incorrect history transaction was attempted before correction.

correction.behavior: Authenticated, store-scoped read-only quote uses the existing server refund caps, previously completed returns and the same cumulative Decimal rounding function as posting. Batched receipt/return reads, no draft or payment creation.
correction.sharedAllocation: Existing allocatedReturnAmount arithmetic extracted unchanged into allocatedReturnDelta and reused for quoting; no pricing, discount or refund policy change.
correction.ui: Both POS journal and history wait for a successful quote, expose loading/error/retry, and fetch the actual draft amount immediately before completion. Zero-value merchandise returns use no payment.

newCases: Discounted partial return quotes 135, with no draft/payment/stock/audit writes
Quote matches every actual return through a 0.01 / 0 / 0.01 cumulative cent split
Rejects excess quantities, duplicate lines, foreign-receipt lines, non-whole quantities and uncompleted sources

limits: Browser replay after the final build is recorded in commerce-verification.json.
Final posting continues to validate availability, remaining tender and idempotency; the read-only quote does not reserve goods or money.
delivery: Local playground only. No schema migration, permission expansion, main merge/push or deployment.
